# apple_invite_beta_tester (Action)

Sends, or sends again, a TestFlight invitation to a tester who belongs to one of the app's groups or builds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_invite_beta_tester" "ann" {
  config {
    app_id         = data.apple_app.example.id
    beta_tester_id = apple_beta_group_tester.ann.beta_tester_id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `beta_tester_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta tester.
